paragraphs: Arrive before dawn for the site briefing and calibrate equipment elevation. During paving, monitor the thickness gauge and edge line and adjust immediately when segregation appears. Follow in sections with the roller and measure density. At midday, maintain the equipment and check oil temperature. In the afternoon, finish edges and add compaction passes. Before leaving, clean equipment and complete records.
